name: Closeout-Review
note: Deliberately-synthetic fixtures (LIN-812) for the close-out/review routing gate — currently UN-eval'ed by the recommender baseline (its real fixtures' `expect` only covered implement/plan/research/breakdown/review; LIN-804 reports close-out firing ~1/3 of the time it should). close-out and review are the positive/negative pair of ONE Step-0/Step-3 decision in lib/prompts/meta-prompt-template.js, driven entirely by COMMENT-TRAIL state: is there a comment where a review recorded an Approve (or Approve — conditional) verdict, and is the work still unmerged / not Done? With such a verdict on record + unmerged → close-out (LIN-550 split; LIN-810 — gate on the verdict, not on a ledger heading); with the work looking done but NO review-verdict comment on the trail → review, never close-out (LIN-811 — close-out requires positive evidence a review actually ran; ambiguous → review). The LIN-823 case (FIX-823-bug-noreview) is the bug-path leak of that same gate: a `bug`-labelled fix posts its OWN rich investigation trail (Root-cause-CONFIRMED + findings + class-check + stepper run-summary) that reads review-ish and fooled the recommender into close-out before review — modeled on the real LIN-799 misroute. The gate must NOT count a bug's author-diagnosis commentary as a fresh-eyes review verdict; only an actual review verdict authorizes close-out → expect review, NOT close-out. Each is a childless In-Progress leaf (no children/focusedChild) so the descent terminates on it. Honest scope: this is live SHAPE-COVERAGE under continuous measurement, NOT a self-reproducing red test — the authoritative red->green guard is the deterministic structural test in tests/unit/openrouter.test.js ('close-out routing gate (LIN-812)', incl. the LIN-823 bug-investigation-exclusion case). LIN-804's 'around a third of the time' is the motivating baseline to validate here, not a target to optimize.

targets.role: landed leaf, review recorded Approve — conditional + non-empty ledger, still unmerged/In Progress (expect -> close-out; the LIN-804 under-fire headline shape)
landed leaf, review recorded a plain Approve + empty ledger, still unmerged/In Progress (LIN-810 — gate on verdict, not heading; expect -> close-out as a cheap pass-through)
landed leaf that LOOKS done (PR merged comment) but has NO review-verdict comment on the trail (LIN-811 — positive review evidence required before close-out; expect -> review, NOT close-out)

landed `bug`-labelled leaf, fix landed (PR open, CI green) with a rich investigation trail (Root-cause-CONFIRMED + decisive experiment + class-check + stepper run-summary) but NO review verdict — modeled on the real LIN-799 misroute (LIN-823 — a bug's own analysis is not a review verdict; expect -> review, NOT close-out)

issue.title: Add retry/backoff to the Linear GraphQL fetch boundary
issue.description:
## Implementation Plan

- Wrap the GraphQL fetch in `lib/linear-fetch.js` with bounded exponential backoff (3 attempts, 250ms base).
- Surface a typed `LinearFetchTimeout` on exhaustion so callers can distinguish it from a 4xx.
- Tests: unit-cover the backoff schedule and the timeout type.

**Session fit:** fits one focused session.

comments.body: Implemented the bounded backoff and the `LinearFetchTimeout` type in `lib/linear-fetch.js`; added unit tests for the schedule and the timeout. PR #812 opened, CI green.

## Review

Walked the diff against the goal: the backoff schedule and the typed timeout match the plan, and the new unit tests cover both. Isolated, not one of a class — no other fetch seam shares this code path.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- The backoff actually fires against a *real* Linear 5xx/timeout — the unit tests stub the transport, so live retry behavior under a genuine upstream outage is unexercised.
- The 250ms base does not compound with the existing Heroku H12 30s router budget on the slowest descent.

**Verdict: Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger.**

issue.title: Flaky: sessions-feed tests flake on the first attempt every CI run
issue.description:
## Symptom

Six tests in `tests/e2e/observation.spec.js` (the sessions feed) ✘ on the first attempt on 30 of 30 recent CI runs, then recover on retry, so CI stays green but the first attempt is non-deterministic.

## Hypothesis

A shared per-test setup race — likely the feed cache not being invalidated between tests, so the first read returns a stale pre-seed payload.

## Done when

All six pass green on the FIRST attempt (no retry markers) across repeated CI runs.

comments.body:
## Root cause — CONFIRMED

The merged sessions-feed cache in `lib/sessions-feed-cache.js` is an in-process singleton with a 5s TTL + stale-while-revalidate. The E2E `clearRuns()` wiped the dispatch/agent-status logs but never invalidated this OUTPUT cache, so a test that cleared state, seeded a fresh run, then read the feed within 5s got the stale pre-seed payload. The seeded session was absent on the first attempt; by Playwright retry (>5s later) the entry had expired/refreshed, so it passed. That's why it was 30/30 first-attempt failures, all green on retry.

## Decisive experiment

Changed ONLY the cache and the flake flipped: bypassing `sessionsFeedCache` (route reads `mergeSessions()` directly) turned 30/30 first-attempt failures → 84/84 green, then 112/112 at `--repeat-each=8`. Single-variable — three rival hypotheses ruled out.

## Autopilot stepper run-summary (session 69690e92)

Driven through a warm single-session stepper, 4 ordered beats within the `bug` kind (review/close-out kept separate for fresh eyes):

- **Beat 1 — ground + reproduce:** set In Progress, re-grounded spec/helpers against HEAD, reproduced the first-attempt flake 30/30 at `--retries=0 --repeat-each=6`.
- **Beat 2 — confirm cause:** single-variable experiment — bypassing only `sessionsFeedCache` flipped 30/30 → 84/84 green; three rival hypotheses ruled out.
- **Beat 3 — fix + verify:** cache-invalidation seam wired into `clearRuns` (prod 5s TTL untouched). Retries-OFF green: observation 112/0, full e2e 915/0, unit 2781/0 (+3 new tests). PR #691 @`30785e5`, CI run success.
- **Beat 4 — findings + class check:** root-cause comment posted; class check found no sibling shares this exact root cause (siblings are separate flake classes).

**Holds:** fix verified locally (first-attempt determinism) and on CI. **Remaining (orchestrator-owned):** review → close-out (merge PR #691, set Done). PR intentionally left unmerged.
